messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated container restarts detected in prod-serving-pool-7. Root cause appears to be GPU OOMs during prefill for large-context requests (~50k+ tokens). Error rate ~20% over the last 5m. Paging eng-oncall.

nisha: Oncall (nisha) here — looking now. Which customers and regions are hitting this?

alex: Seeing repeated SIGKILLs on containers handling redwood-13b-long. GPU logs show cuMemAlloc failed and oom-kill from cgroup on GPU0/1. A few nodes (node-prod-7) have multiple restarts in last 3m.

mike: Logs: http://logs.internal/prod/serving/2977773333 — sample: ```Killed process 2345 (python) total-vm:125G anon-rss:62G file-rss:0k oom-kill: cgroup memory limit exceeded
GPU0: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
Traceback: ...```

nisha: Quick mitigations we can try now: 1) Apply gateway prefill trim for very long prompts, 2) route >32k token requests to a short-model fallback, 3) bump KV cache eviction aggressiveness. Who can push a config?

eng-oncall: Applying gateway rule now: set max_prefill_tokens=20000 for prod-serving-pool-7. Patching and rolling config across gateways. ETA ~90s. :shipit:

alex: Also flipping kvcache.eviction_rate += 10% on serving hosts to free up memory for active sessions.

mike: Customer-impact: CS reports errors from AcmeApp and BetaSearch starting ~04:12 UTC. Both using long-context features in EU region. Others appear unaffected so far.

customer-success: Notifying AcmeApp and BetaSearch with suggested workaround: reduce prompt length or pin to shorter model until cleared.

nisha: If errors don't drop under 5% in 5m, plan: drain worst nodes and restart containers to clear fragmentation. @sre-rotation stand by for node drain.

sre-rotation: Standing by. Preparing drain for node-prod-7 and node-prod-9; will cordon then evict pods, rolling restarts.

ops-bot: Drain scheduled: node-prod-7 at 04:20 UTC, node-prod-9 at 04:25 UTC. Traffic will be rebalanced.

alex: After gateway patch, error rate down to ~7% but still seeing one noisy neighbor with repeated allocations failing — likely GPU memory fragmentation from long-lived KV caches and partial evictions.

mike: Proposal: add explicit routing fallback for requests >40k tokens to cpu-coldmodel-v2 (with a warning header) to avoid further OOMs while we stabilize. I can push the rule.

customer-success: AcmeApp confirmed they're running a live experiment. They've applied temporary rollback on their side for the experiment cohort.

nisha: Handoff: I'm handing paging to night oncall @maria at 04:35 UTC. Please create an incident ticket with logs, mitigation steps taken, and customer-impact notes.

maria: Acknowledged. Taking over monitoring. I'll keep the incident open for at least 60m and coordinate customer comms with CS. If errors spike again, escalate to eng-runtime.

nisha: Thanks everyone. Initial root cause summary to include in postmortem: extremely long prefill/large context requests exposing GPU memory fragmentation + insufficient automatic trimming, which led to cuMemAlloc failures and container restarts. We'll capture action items: gateway prefill limits, routing fallbacks for huge requests, kvcache tuning, and a follow-up to improve early throttling.

maria: Logging handoff complete. Updating incident ticket now and tagging eng-runtime and devex for follow-up.
